title: ExecutionRequest
description: Submitted to the execution interface (ADR-0003 §4). The shape encodes the six substitutability rules of ADR-0003 §3: argv arrays rather than shell strings, an explicit environment allowlist rather than inheritance, artifact references rather than paths, and mandatory timeout, limits and network policy.

argv.description: Fully resolved argument vector. ADR-0005 §5: this is produced by the platform from a named command profile. A model never authors it, and no shell is involved at any layer.

cwd.description: Workspace-relative working directory, validated against the grant's pathScope. Absolute paths are rejected: ADR-0003 §3 forbids any host path crossing this boundary.

envAllowlist.description: Explicit key/value pairs. Nothing is inherited from the host environment, which is what stops ambient developer credentials reaching executed commands.
